questions.prompt: How many total hours do all domestic cats in the United States spend sleeping collectively in a single day?
reasoning: Estimate the pet cat population in the United States at around 60 million.
Assume the average cat sleeps about 15 hours per day.
Multiply 60 million cats by 15 hours to get 900 million total collective hours.

questions.prompt: How many individual roof tiles are used to cover the standard pitched roofs of all residential houses in Australia?
reasoning: Estimate the number of detached residential houses in Australia to be about 6 million.
Assume an average roof surface area of 200 square metres per house, resulting in 1.2 billion square metres total.
Assume each square metre of tiled roofing requires about 12 to 15 individual tiles, yielding roughly 15 billion tiles in total.

questions.prompt: How many total individual drops of water fall from all domestic kitchen faucets left dripping at a slow rate globally in a single day?
reasoning: Estimate that a small fraction of the 2 billion households worldwide have a slowly dripping faucet, say 10 million faucets.
A slow drip typically releases about 10 drops per minute.
Calculate the drops per day per faucet: 10 drops per minute times 60 minutes times 24 hours equals 14,400 drops per day.
Multiply 10 million dripping faucets by 14,400 drops to arrive at approximately 144 billion drops daily.
